lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Series of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 10-12 discernible vertical columns along the visible lateral flank, extending from the posterior of the pectoral fin towards the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like lattice, most visible in the mid-body region where contrast is highest.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin shows a sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 low-contrast, high-luminance blobs across its visible lateral surface.
